The '''Lorattick Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]. The [[Ardan resistance]] used the nebula as a hyperspace jump point in order to catch [[Var Narek]], a traitor to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="OAA1" />
